name: What preparation is needed before bay window installation day?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before bay window installation day?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your bay window installation day, we recommend clearing the area around the window, both inside and out, to allow our team unobstructed access. This includes moving furniture, removing wall hangings, and clearing any landscaping that might impede work. Protecting nearby flooring and furniture with drop cloths is also advisable. For homes in Fremont, where space can be a premium, ensuring clear access helps our crew work efficiently and safely, speeding up the installation process and reducing potential delays.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prior to installation, clear the area around the window both inside and out, move furniture, and protect flooring to ensure unobstructed access for the team.
